roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for nursing staff, fostering continuous professional growth. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, overseeing surveillance, prevention strategies, and compliance with regulatory guidelines. This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $40.00 - $42.00 per hour, based on experience.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers the flexibility of PRN work while making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

This opportunity comes with a competitive hourly rate ranging from $38 to $49, reflecting your expertise and commitment. To further support your transition, a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus is available.

As an SLP, you will be instrumental in providing comprehensive speech, language, and swallowing services to patients, helping them regain vital communication and cognitive skills. Join a team committed to excellence and patient-centered care.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38 - $49, plus a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.
